notes.title: Patch 1.0.230314 | Minor Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43538146/bcf252037bba46e5ad1d414c0e4bc44f199b301b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dimensional travelers! We have some small visual improvements for you in this patch.

Here's a list of the changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed some of the tutorial slides
[*]Added the Buildings in the map rotation
[*]Added a button to join the discord community
[*]Added animations when buying the season pass and when collecting season rewards
[/list]

Follow-us on our social medias and [url=https://discord.com/invite/4FYerSDQyw]Discord[/url] for upcoming news and organized play!

-The Netherverse Development Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.230309 | Release Day!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43538146/bcf252037bba46e5ad1d414c0e4bc44f199b301b.jpg[/img]

Greetings, dimensional travelers! It is with great joy that we bring you our official release build! We've put our sweat and tears into this one, we hope you enjoy it. We'll also be monitoring the game over the next few days for potential issues.

Here's a list of the changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed crashes when playing in a friends lobby
[*]Added shop and season progress
[*]Added ability to choose player title
[*]3 maps are now available! Forest, Shipwreck and Buildings
[*]Fixed issue where Luna did not have sounds during her takedown animation
[/list]

Follow-us on our social medias and [url=https://discord.com/invite/4FYerSDQyw]Discord community[/url] for upcoming news and organized play!

-The Netherverse Development Team

notes.title: PATCH 0.2.030123 | Lobbies!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43538146/bcf252037bba46e5ad1d414c0e4bc44f199b301b.jpg[/img]

Welcome dimensional travelers to our March update! We've been hard at work gathering your feedback and patching every hole we can find.

Here's a list of the changes:
[list]
[*]Lobbies for up to 6 players have been added. Group up with some friends and duke it out!
[*]Various performance and stability improvements for a better play experience.
[*]Shipwreck map is currently available. A new one is coming soon!
[/list]

Follow-us on our social medias and [url=https://discord.com/invite/4FYerSDQyw]Discord community[/url] for upcoming news and organized play!

-The Netherverse Development Team
